name: Course Tracker
author: erikzett

sections.description:
Course Tracker is a modern, user-friendly plugin for managing courses and tracking student lesson completion. Designed for speed and simplicity, it works with any theme using a WordPress menu as your course navigation. Students can check off lessons, see their progress, and (optionally) back up or restore their data.

Features:

  • Easy setup – just assign a WordPress menu for your course.
  • Students mark lessons as complete with a click.
  • Visual navigation with checkmarks and arrows.
  • Progress bar and course outline display.
  • Slide-in course tracker panel (optional).
  • Works with all themes and page builders.
  • Minimal code, fast and standards-compliant.

Perfect for:
– Course creators who want simple progress tracking.
– Membership sites and online classes.
– DIY educators who want flexibility and privacy.
– Budget-conscious developers and admins who are creating a DIY course.
– Freeing yourself from expensive LMS subscriptions

Usage

After setup, use these shortcodes in your pages or templates:

  • [ctrkr_nav] – Course navigation with checkmarks.
  • [ctrkr_complete_button text=" "] – Button to mark the current lesson as complete.
  • [ctrkr_nav_arrows] – Previous/Next lesson arrows.
  • [ctrkr_course_outline] – Progress bar and outline table.
  • [ctrkr_lesson_position] – Shows plain text: Lesson N of Total.
  • [ctrkr_progress_text] – Shows < Completed X of Y lessons > with prev/next arrows.

Example:
Add [ctrkr_nav] to your sidebar or course page for navigation.
Add [ctrkr_complete_button] to each lesson page.

Students can also export their progress as a backup file (JSON) and import it later if needed.

Settings

  • Course Navigation Menu: Select the WordPress menu that represents your course.
  • Show Navigation Title: Display a title above the course navigation.
  • Slide-in Tracker Panel: Optionally enable a floating slide-in menu for navigation.
  • Styling: Change button color with color picker. Use provide examples for more customization.
  • Student Reports: See your students progress and export to a spreadsheet.

External Services

This plugin connects to SureCart via api.surecart.com for license verification (to unlock the premium version).
– What: The entered license key is sent to SureCart for validation.
– When: Only when you enter or remove a license key in the plugin settings.
– Data sent: License key (no student or course data is sent).
– Purpose: To enable premium features after purchase.
– SureCart Privacy Policy

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/course-tracker directory or install via the WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > Course Tracker to select your course navigation menu and configure options.
  4. Add shortcodes (see below) to your lesson or course pages.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin store student progress?

Yes. Student progress is stored privately in your WordPress database for each logged-in user, with no data sent to any third party. All plugin settings and user progress are included in regular WordPress database backups. To back up your WordPress site (including plugin data), use any popular backup plugin such as UpdraftPlus.

Can I use this with any theme?

Yes! Create a WordPress menu to organize your course. Insert the provided shortcodes into your page template (such as your lessons page or sidebar).

Is this plugin free?

Yes. You can have 20 users (including admin) track their lessons for each license. Otherwise, no other restrictions. After 20 users, you can opt to unlock it for unlimited users for a small fee, which helps support this plugin and bring more improvements.

  • Initial version released at WordPress Plugin Directory
  • Improved button styling.
  • Settings page improvements.

1.1.3

  • Fixed domain handling and improved data sanitation, readme corrections and plugin code.
  • No changes to plugin features or functionality.

1.1.0

  • Plugin completely refactored for simplicity and security.
  • Plugin always saves progress permanently to WP database even in free mode.
  • Free mode allows up to 20 users including admin – paid is unlimited
  • A new nav slide-in option can also be activated if needed.
  • Removed CSS edit box for simplicity – added a color select for button
  • All features now use unique prefixes and proper escaping.
  • New: Color Picker and Slide-in tracker panel.
  • Improved / Simplified: Admin settings and license activation.

1.0.0

  • Initial working version released at rankbydesign.com.
